dedupe_keys.name: rescuenet a high resolution uav semantic segmentation dataset for natural disaster damage assessment

description: RescueNet: A High Resolution UAV Semantic Segmentation Dataset for Natural Disaster Damage Assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Maryam Rahnemoonfar et al. Recent advancements in computer vision and deep learning techniques have facilitated notable progress in scene understanding, thereby assisting rescue teams in achieving precise damage assessment. In this paper, we present RescueNet, a curated high-resolution post-disaster dataset that includes detailed classification and semantic segmentation annotations. This dataset aims to facilitate scene understanding in the aftermath of natural disasters. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
